subject: ClearFlow onboarding: provisional PO, spend cap, and item splits
messages:
From: Brenda Lugo <brenda@clearflow.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearFlow onboarding docs + initial PO request

Hi Kimberly / Priyom,

Thanks for the call this morning — attached are the completed onboarding form and our W-9 for ClearFlow Systems. We're hoping to move forward this month and would like a PO for implementation and support. Proposed topline: $75,000 annual commitment split across the following lines:
- Implementation services: $30,000
- Annual support & maintenance: $35,000
- Optional training credits: $10,000

Attachments: onboarding_form_filled.pdf, clearflow_w9.pdf

Can you confirm the expected PO number cadence and whether we should split into multiple POs or line items to align with internal spend caps? Happy to provide any additional fields for your procurement form.

Thanks,
Brenda Lugo
Director of Partnerships
ClearFlow Systems
brenda@clearflow.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: brenda@clearflow.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearFlow onboarding docs + initial PO request

Brenda — thanks for sending these over. I confirmed we received onboarding_form_filled.pdf and the W-9. A couple quick notes before we issue a PO:

1) Finance policy: anything > $50k total requires a spend cap exception and director approval.
2) Our standard per-line spend cap is $40k before additional sign-off; for onboarding we usually split implementation from recurring support.
3) Please confirm the bank details (ACH instructions) and whether ClearFlow can accept a provisional PO with escrow until procurement and finance finalize the spend cap.

If you can split the Implementation and Support into two lines (Implementation $30k / Support $35k) and indicate which deliverables map to the Implementation line, that will speed internal routing.

I'll loop in Jonas from Finance for the approval path.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearFlow onboarding docs + initial PO request

Kimberly / team — reviewing ClearFlow's numbers. Short summary:
- Total request $75k; line split as proposed looks reasonable from a product-fit perspective.
- Finance needs a documented justification for the $35k recurring support line to sign the spend-cap exception.
- We can issue a provisional PO (PO-987654) for $50k against Implementation + partial Support, with an escrow flag that prevents invoicing beyond the provisional cap until the exception is approved.

Please hold final issuance until we get the vendor bank details and a brief SOW for what's included in Implementation vs Support. If ClearFlow can reduce the recurring line to $25k for year one (with training credits billed separately) we can avoid the formal director-level approval and issue the full PO faster.

Quoted for clarity:
> "Please confirm the expected PO number cadence and whether we should split into multiple POs or line items to align with internal spend caps?"

Action items:
- Kimberly: request clear SOW breakdown and bank details from vendor.
- Brenda / ClearFlow: confirm willingness to accept provisional PO and revise line amounts (optional).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Head of Procurement Operations (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Brenda Lugo <brenda@clearflow.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearFlow onboarding docs + initial PO request

Hi Kimberly / Priyom — thanks for the quick review. ClearFlow can accommodate the split. Updated proposed lines:
- Implementation services (SOW A): $30,000 — includes integration and initial deployment (deliverables listed below).
- Annual support & maintenance (SOW B): $25,000 — standard 24/7 support, minor customization hours capped at 40/year.
- Training credits (SOW C): $10,000 — optional; invoiced upon scheduling.

We agree to a provisional PO with an escrow flag and can accept PO-987654 for $55,000 to cover Implementation + partial Support. Bank details attached; also attached draft PO for your procurement team to review (draft_po_CF-987.pdf).

Forwarding the SOW sections below for matching to PO lines. Let me know if you want us to split into two separate POs (one for Implementation, one for Support) or keep one PO with distinct line items.

Best,
Brenda Lugo
Director of Partnerships
ClearFlow Systems
Attachments: draft_po_CF-987.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: brenda@clearflow.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 12:31:00 -0700
Subject: ClearFlow onboarding: provisional PO issued (PO-987654)

Brenda — thank you. Per Priyom's note and Jonas's verbal approval this morning, procurement has issued a provisional PO: PO-987654 for $55,000 (Implementation $30,000 + Support partial $25,000). The PO includes an escrow flag and will allow invoicing up to the provisional cap.

Next steps:
- Procurement to attach final PO to vendor record and send DocuSign for signatures (link below).
- Finance to process an exception request for the remaining Support funding; if approved, we will amend the PO to the full $75,000.
- Vendor to submit invoices against PO-987654; any invoices beyond the provisional cap will be held until the finance exception completes.

Attachments: final_po_RWF-20270423-987654.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Agreement/CF-987-DOC

Thanks for the rapid turnaround — welcome to Redwood.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
